subject: Rhacophyton open non-laminate frond framework
factual_scope: Rhacophyton ceratangium sterile whole-habit educational reconstruction. Andrews and Phillips primary abstract supports bipinnate non-laminate fronds and woody axes. A published secondary historical reconstruction depicts spiral fronds; other literature describes paired rows, so whole-habit/spiral arrangement is explicitly interpretive. Nominal size, green palette and module counts are art choices, not replicated specimen measurements.
identifying_features: One slender upright axis with eight individually spaced frond frameworks around it in a historical spiral reconstruction; not a whorl of modern broad fronds.
Each of eight rachises bears four pairs of lateral pinnae; each pinna carries four slender forklets with open bifurcated non-laminate tips. No broad blade or enlarged spherical bud.
Branches occupy genuine depth with modest curvature and lateral divergence; basal contact is minimal, no asserted root reconstruction. Sterile individual: no flowers, fruit or sporangia modeled.

scale.accuracy: Nominal artistic targets only, not exact hard equalities or fossil measurements. No invented micrometre-scale geometric gate.
